# SentinelOS

> SentinelOS is a project platform for human-reviewed emergency response coordination. It connects incident reports with dispatcher triage, hospital capacity, response team offers, and volunteer tasks.

## Public overview

- [How the platform works](/#how-it-works): report, dispatch review, and response workflow.
- [Who the platform serves](/#who-its-for): citizens, dispatchers, hospitals, response teams, and volunteers.
- [Create an account](/register): public sign-up for citizens and volunteers.
- [Full project and capability description](/llms-full.txt)

## Important limitations

- SentinelOS does not automatically dispatch emergency services.
- Creating a response offer does not mean the hospital or response team accepted it.
- Resource recommendations depend on stored hospital capacity, service tags, ambulance availability, and recent location updates.
- Map distances are straight-line estimates unless a separate routing service is configured.
- The platform does not replace local emergency services or emergency phone numbers.
- Operational pages require authentication and must not be treated as public content.
